verses.text: Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
lines: Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity.
I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.

verses.text: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
lines: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me.
Try my heart and my mind.

verses.text: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
lines: For your loving kindness is before my eyes.
I have walked in your truth.

verses.text: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
lines: I have not sat with deceitful men,
neither will I go in with hypocrites.

verses.text: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
lines: I hate the assembly of evildoers,
and will not sit with the wicked.

verses.text: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,
lines: I will wash my hands in innocence,
so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,

verses.text: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.
lines: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard
and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

verses.text: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
lines: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house,
the place where your glory dwells.

verses.text: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;
lines: Don’t gather my soul with sinners,
nor my life with bloodthirsty men;

verses.text: in whose hands is wickedness, their right hand is full of bribes.
lines: in whose hands is wickedness,
their right hand is full of bribes.

verses.text: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
lines: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity.
Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

verses.text: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.
lines: My foot stands in an even place.
In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.
